none: PAS NLM-9B1FA0: Patera handle from Market Rasen
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Patera Handle. Cast disc with central aperture of diameter11.4mm, and part of a handle lug. The central aperture has a circumferential border of a plain raised rib. The outer border comprises a circumferential plain rib, and an inner rib bearing closely-spaced incised diagonal billeting. The projecting handle bears stamped decoration resembling ring and dot, a chip-carved border,…
